PAEDIATRIC ED TRIAGE NOTE

14-month-old girl. Brought in by mum.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT
Fever and poor feeding for 2 days, increasingly drowsy today.

TRIAGE
Mum reports she has been off her feeds since yesterday, refusing the bottle. Not herself - usually very smiley and playful, today just wants to be held and is not interested in her toys. Fewer wet nappies than usual.

On assessment: looks pale, peripherally cool to touch. Subcostal recession noted. No rash seen, blanching when pressed. Not floppy. Drowsy but rouses to voice. ?meningitis given drowsiness and reduced feeding - to discuss with paediatric registrar.

Older sibling at home recently had chickenpox.

PLAN: urgent paediatric review, bloods, observations.

output.extraction_reasoning: (1) AMBIGUITIES: '?meningitis' is a query/differential, not a sign in this schema, so it is not extracted as an entity; the drowsiness and poor feeding that prompted it are extracted on their own merits. (2) ASSERTION/APPLICABILITY: fever is not an AcuteSign member so omitted. 'off her feeds'/'refusing the bottle' -> POOR_FEEDING (positive). 'not herself'/'wants to be held' -> PARENT_REPORTS_NOT_THEMSELVES (positive). 'not interested in toys' -> REDUCED_PLAY (positive). 'fewer wet nappies' -> REDUCED_URINE_OUTPUT (positive). 'looks pale' -> PALLOR (positive). 'peripherally cool' -> COLD_PERIPHERIES (positive). 'subcostal recession' -> CHEST_RECESSION (positive). 'drowsy but rouses to voice' -> both DROWSINESS and REDUCED_CONSCIOUSNESS (positive; greedy extraction of overlapping signs from the same phrase). 'No rash, blanching when pressed' -> NON_BLANCHING_RASH (negated). 'Not floppy' -> FLOPPINESS (negated). Sibling's chickenpox is not an AcuteSign and refers to another child, so omitted. (3) OMISSIONS: fever, no numeric vitals to infer from, '?meningitis' is a query not a documented sign. Prioritised precision where support was uncertain.

document_content.doc_summary: 14-month-old with 2 days fever and poor feeding, increasingly drowsy. On assessment pale, cool peripheries, subcostal recession, drowsy rousing to voice. No rash, not floppy. Query meningitis, for urgent paediatric review.
